rules.name: Registration Fee Requested
rules.description: The job description requests a registration, application, or processing fee to apply or secure a spot.

rules.name: Training Fee Required
rules.description: Requests payment for training materials or mandatory certifications before starting employment.

rules.name: Security Deposit Requested
rules.description: Requests an upfront refundable security deposit for equipment, laptops, or remote work setups.

rules.name: Upfront Equipment Purchase
rules.description: Instructs candidates to purchase their own laptops or equipment with promised reimbursement checks.

rules.name: Identity Document Requested Upfront
rules.description: Requests sensitive government identifiers (like Aadhaar, PAN card, or Passport) before any interview.
rules.explanation: Government ID numbers should only be collected during background checks after a formal contract is offered.

rules.name: Bank Details Requested
rules.description: Requests bank accounts, card numbers, or direct deposit setup details prior to formal background checks.
rules.explanation: Sharing direct deposit details prior to formal selection raises a high risk of identity theft and bank fraud.

rules.name: OTP / UPI Pin Request
rules.description: Asks candidates to share verification codes, OTPs, or UPI PINs.
rules.explanation: OTPs and PINs are private and sharing them exposes candidates to financial fraud.

rules.name: Direct Hiring Without Interview
rules.description: Guarantees job offers or direct placement without any formal screening.

rules.name: Guaranteed Employment Promise
rules.description: Guarantees employment regardless of experience or qualification.

rules.name: Urgent Action Required
rules.description: Creates synthetic panic by demanding payment or replies within an extremely short, restrictive window.

rules.name: Artificial Scarcity Pressure
rules.description: Uses artificial scarcity language to pressure candidates into making emotionally driven, rash decisions.

rules.name: Public Domain Recruiter Email
rules.description: Mentions contact details routing to free, public email addresses.

rules.name: WhatsApp-Only Recruiter Contact
rules.description: Recruiter directs candidates to communicate exclusively via personal WhatsApp chats or links.

rules.name: Telegram-Only Recruiter Contact
rules.description: Recruiter directs candidates to communicate exclusively via Telegram channels.
